header: THE RULES OF AN EMPLOYEE RECORD (step 66a; my request, 1 Nov 2026). PURE: I run the same function in the panel (so a mistake is shown as it is typed) and on the server (so nothing depends on the panel). Ticket six digits, not starting with 0. An executive's ticket starts with 4 (and the cohort follows from it: it is never typed); 49xxxx is a direct recruit (a Management Trainee); any other digit after the 4 is promoted. Name letters, spaces and . ' - only; kept in capitals, one space between words (as the roster has it). Designation must exist, and must fit the ticket: a non-executive grade (S-1 ... S-11) for a non-executive, a managerial or medical grade for an executive. Department must exist, and must fit the cohort (a department reserved to executives is not for a non-executive, and the other way round). SAIL P.No. required for a new employee (it is the first password of his login account); letters and digits. Contact (contact.ts) an executive: NIC mail @sail.in, web-mail @saildsp.co.in, a CUG mobile (94347 + 9, 2 or 3), OPTIONAL; a non-executive: one e-mail (any domain) and an optional mobile. Dates (only the HOD of C&IT sees and sets them) a real calendar day; born not before 1930 and not in the future; joined not in the future; joined at 18 or later, at 23 or later for a direct recruit; not past the retirement day (the last day of the month in which 60 is reached). Joining after 32 is allowed but WARNED (an age relaxation may be real). I use Luxon only.

symbols.name: isTicket
doc: A ticket number: six digits, and I never allow it to start with 0.

members.name: canEditDates
doc: Only the HOD of C&IT sees and sets the two dates. For anybody else I ignore them and keep the stored ones.

members.name: fixedTicket
doc: In a change the ticket is fixed, so it is not an input.

members.name: requirePno
doc: A new employee must have a SAIL P.No.; in a change I require it only when he has one already.

doc: The global seniority rank, by the HR formula: the grade's order x 10000 + the position in the grade.

behaviours: a good record is accepted and tidied: the name in capitals with single spaces, the P.No. in capitals, e-mail in lower case
the cohort follows from the ticket (never typed): 4xxxxx executive, anything else not
ticket "${bad}" is refused (exactly 6 digits)
in a change the ticket is fixed: what is typed is ignored
name "${bad}" is refused
name "${good2}" is accepted
an executive cannot hold a non-executive grade, a non-executive cannot hold an executive one
a doctor's (medical) grade is an executive grade
a department reserved to executives is refused for a non-executive, and the other way round; a shared one fits both
an unknown or missing designation or department is refused, in words
the position in the grade: empty is fine (last in the grade), 1 to 9999 is fine, 0, 10000, 2.5 and words are not
an e-mail is optional but must be one; a P.No. is optional but letters and digits only
born 30 Jun 1975, joined 12 Oct 2001: fine
not a date / not a real day: refused, in words
born in the future or before 1930: refused; joined in the future: refused
past the retirement day (60 reached in an earlier month): refused; 60 reached this month: still on the roll
joined the day before the 18th birthday: refused; on it: fine (a promoted executive)
a direct recruit (49xxxx) who joined at 22: refused (23 is the minimum); at exactly 23: fine
joined after 32: accepted but WARNED (an age relaxation may be real); at 32 exactly: no warning
either date may be empty (the HOD may not have both): no error
for anybody but the HOD the two dates are IGNORED (even rubbish raises no error, and nothing is carried)
isTicket: six digits not starting with 0
a new employee must have a SAIL P.No.: empty is refused in words; in a change it is not required
an executive's NIC mail must end with @sail.in (any case), the web-mail with @saildsp.co.in; each other domain is refused in words
both mail fields are optional for an executive
an executive's CUG mobile: 94347 then 9 (usual), 2 or 3 (exceptions) then four digits are accepted
...anything else is refused in words: 94347 then 4, another prefix, nine or eleven digits, letters
...the usual ways of writing a number are understood (+91, 0, spaces, dashes)
an executive's mobile is OPTIONAL (it arrives later; owner, 2 Nov 2026): empty or blanks are accepted, in an add and in a change; typed, it must be a CUG number (only letters is refused, not ignored)
a non-executive's mobile: empty is fine, a good number is fine, only letters is refused (not ignored)
the general e-mail field is not an executive's: whatever is in it is ignored (nothing carried)
a non-executive: one e-mail, ANY domain (gmail, hotmail, sail.in ...), optional
a non-executive's mobile: optional; any 10 digits not starting with 0; the CUG pattern is not required of him
a non-executive has no NIC or web-mail field: if the browser sends them they are ignored (nothing carried)
a non-executive's record is complete without any contact at all
masks: a mobile as its first six digits and x; an e-mail as xxxxxx and the domain; nothing for nothing
normalizeMobile: digits only, +91 and a leading 0 removed
the HR formula for seniority: the grade's order x 10000 + the position
cleanText: control characters and runs of spaces go, the length is limited
the live line under the dates: age, service, the farewell day, the jubilee day
...empty for a missing or impossible date
